instruction: In src/_pytest/logging.py, make LogCaptureFixture.filtering leave a filter that was already on the handler alone. Before "self.handler.addFilter(filter_)" add the line "already_present = filter_ in self.handler.filters", and make that addFilter call run only "if not already_present:" (indent it under that line). Then make the removeFilter call in the finally block run only under "if not already_present:" too.
